Scenario: A circular value network consists of one or many actors that are working together towards a common goal. To reach this goal actors make use of inputs in the form of competencies and resources according to a specified logic. The circular value network outputs are the value proposition in it self, but also the possible secondary values in products, materials or competencies that could be useful in other contexts.
